newsitem.title: FINLAND: Thin Helsinki bourse closes lower, may fall more.
newsitem.headline: Thin Helsinki bourse closes lower, may fall more.

text.p: Finnish shares closed lower on Monday and brokers said the stock market could fall further in reaction to recent gains.
The Helsinki bourse HEX all-share index ended 10.6 points or 0.5 percent down at 2,133.75 -- still 10 percent up on the July 25 start of a five-week nearly uninterrupted bullish streak.
"We are still on an upward trend, but we may see a downward correction," one broker said.

Trade was cautious due to Wall Street's weak performance last Friday and Monday's Labor Day holiday in the United States. Turnover was subdued at 165 million markka with telecoms group Nokia accounting for 25 percent.

Metals and mining group Outokumpu fell 3.50 markka or four percent to 81.00 markka after releasing a profit warning. Outokumpu said lower stainless steel and copper prices would make its full-year result "significantly weaker" than in 1995.
